consideredAndDeclined.observation: My turn-1 repair asked for two things: the D-086 posture, and an explicit statement of what the recording establishes. Only the first is in the turn-2 subject. Decision 3 records that NT-3 and NT-5 remain leftover-design and that gates 2 and 3 do not hold, in adjacent sentences, without stating the causal link.
consideredAndDeclined.whyDeclined: I framed that second limb as keeping Decision 3 true once the contradiction was removed, and Decision 3 is now straightforwardly true: nothing in Decisions 1 or 2 implies gate 3 holds, because naming is only one limb of gate 3 and two of the seven remainders are unnamed. More importantly, an entry that ruled on whether gate 3's naming limb is satisfied for a subset of classes would be making a D-056 eligibility determination, and D-056 gate 4 reserves that to a later dedicated SATISFIED-grade cycle. Pressing for it would push this recording outside its authority, so I withdraw that half rather than charge it. Both facts a later cycle needs are on the record here.
